questions.explanation: ∫_{-1}^1 x^4 dx = 2/5; divided by 2 = 1/5. The function is even, so the integral is nonzero.

questions.subject: CALCULUS_I
questions.learningObjective: Compute average value of a function on [0,π/2]
questions.stem: A study group revises the average value of f(x)=sin x on [0,π/2].
questions.explanation: Average = (2/π)∫_0^{π/2} sin x dx = (2/π)*1 = 2/π ≈ 0.637. Forgetting the 2/π gives 1.

questions.subject: CALCULUS_I
questions.learningObjective: Apply u-substitution to a definite integral with an exponential inner function
questions.stem: A study group revises ∫_0^1 x e^{x^2} dx.
questions.explanation: Let u=x^2, du=2x dx. ∫_0^1 x e^{x^2} dx = (1/2)∫_0^1 e^u du = (e-1)/2. Forgetting 1/2 gives e-1.
